import json
from datetime import datetime, date

# Q1: construction ended 2016-09-25, took 10 years
X = date(2016, 9, 25).year - 10

# Q2: months between 2020-06-28 and 2022-09-28
b1 = date(2020, 6, 28)
b2 = date(2022, 9, 28)
Y = (b2.year - b1.year) * 12 + (b2.month - b1.month)
if b2.day < b1.day:
    Y -= 1

# Q4: cutoff built as Xp-Yp-Zp 18:49:42 (year-month-day)
cutoff = datetime(Xp, Yp, Zp, 18, 49, 42)

exams = {
    "Jason": datetime(1996, 9, 23, 23, 26, 0),
    "Emma": datetime(1997, 9, 19, 19, 42, 0),
    "Joe": datetime(2050, 8, 21, 19, 51, 0),
    "Bob": datetime(1822, 9, 18, 21, 19, 0),
    "Dan": datetime(2050, 8, 21, 15, 55, 5),
}

result = sorted(n for n, t in exams.items() if t < cutoff)

print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": "[" + ", ".join(result) + "]",
    "evidence": {
        "X": X, "Y": Y, "Z": Z,
        "X'": Xp, "Y'": Yp, "Z'": Zp,
        "cutoff": cutoff.isoformat(),
        "exams": {k: v.isoformat() for k, v in exams.items()},
    },
}))
